statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The monitoring directly addresses the patient's current clinical presentation
The monitoring is required to determine the cause of the recurrent symptoms
